name: Lucas Santos
tagline: I build web apps people rely on every day: booking flows, business systems and AI tools, with React, TypeScript, Node and PostgreSQL.
about:
I've been shipping production web software for over six years, mostly as a remote engineer for North American companies: travel booking platforms, an agricultural cooperative's business system, a legal AI chat tool and marketing sites.

Before code I was a graphic designer and an English teacher. Design gave me an eye for detail in UI, and teaching made me good at explaining technical things to non-technical people. I'm a native speaker of both English and Portuguese, and I studied Computer Science at UFOP.

Outside client work I build tools for my own Linux setup and home lab, and you'll find a few of them in my projects.

highlights.label: across travel, legal, agriculture and media
